svg.title: Local Missions Azure development reference architecture
svg.desc: Senior architecture view of the Local Missions Azure development target after the three-resource retained-state bootstrap was applied and migrated, before control-plane or workload deployment.

g.text: Local Missions — Azure development reference architecture
Senior-principal review view • repository-aligned M5 Phase B target • 2026-09-01
* Subscription verified; later workload SKU, quota, and policy availability remains unverified.
Untrusted network • no credentials embedded in clients
External identities and workload federation are separately gated
Open gate: real registrations and provider flows
No client secrets • short-lived OIDC tokens
Planned only; identities do not exist yet
GitHub environments • independent approvals • saved-plan binding • no active deployment workflow
main only • no self-review • no bypass
Plan cannot apply or delete; exact artifact SHA binds review.
Apply, cloud tests, rollback, destroy, and reconciliation each
require later explicit approvals. No auto-approve or broad target.
Same-day disposable workload: eight hours maximum and no later than 11:00 PM New York
Synthetic data only; no participant media, live payments, or production identity
$2 first smoke run; $5 fallback max; $100 monthly alert budget; 50% / 80% / 100% alerts
State and live inventory independently reconcile to zero exact-stamp workload resources
Empty landing zone and retained control stay separate; cleanup failure remains open
STATE + 20-RESOURCE CONTROL PLANE LIVE AND VERIFIED. DISPOSABLE WORKLOAD NOT DEPLOYED.
Azure subscription administrative boundary — candidate East US 2
Retained state is live; control/workload remain unprovisioned; later quotas, policies, and alert destination remain open
Retained control + workload landing zone — 20 resources live
State live • control target: two custom roles • five workload assignments • three state assignments
Control group + retained Local Missions workload landing zone
3 identities/FICs • 2 custom roles • budget/action group • empty workload RG • 8 scoped RBAC
Reader plan; group-scoped apply/destroy; five delegated app-data roles; Owner forbidden.
27 core + 3 apps = 30 • exact stamp • group not created/deleted • activation disabled
Environment public endpoint • HTTPS only • reviewed dev CIDRs
Single revision • max 1 inactive revision • 0.25 vCPU / 0.5 GiB each
TLS 1.2 • public endpoints temporarily enabled • default-deny + narrow IP rules
Phase B dev exposure only — not an approved production edge or data-plane topology
Local auth off • 30-day capped retention • sanitized correlation
VNet integration • private endpoints • private DNS
Managed edge / WAF / production ingress decision
Egress controls and trusted service paths
NOT IMPLEMENTED — mandatory staging / production architecture gate
System browser OIDC Authorization Code + PKCE; exact redirect, issuer, audience, scopes, nonce, and JWKS.
iOS presents short-lived bearer/session context over HTTPS; authorization is server/database derived.
Browser reaches the CIDR-restricted dashboard HTTPS ingress; no employee role exists in the iOS mode switch.
Dashboard uses the API FQDN over HTTPS; API remains the authorization and domain boundary.
Blob Contributor, Service Bus Sender, Key Vault Secrets User; PostgreSQL database grants remain an open gate.
Worker UAMI receives mission-events, processes retries/DLQ paths, and accesses Blob/Key Vault without shared keys.
Each app UAMI has AcrPull only; runtime images require immutable SHA-256 digests.
Container logs and application correlation flow to capped Log Analytics/Application Insights with local auth off.
Protected job requests a short-lived OIDC token; no Azure client secret is stored in GitHub.
Plan = Reader; apply/destroy are condition-limited at the Local Missions landing zone only.
Alerts route to a monitored owner; expiry controller warns, then drives reviewed teardown and reconciliation.
Solid = runtime • purple = identity • green = managed identity/RBAC
Orange dashed = privileged control • grey dashed boundary = deferred
